newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs ease pre-weekend.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs ease pre-weekend.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts drifted lower ahead of the weekend in slow trade as the market took its lead from an easier local market, traders said.
They said the market was consolidating after recent strong gains, and expected strength to return next week.
Few fresh factors were seen affecting prices, but much depended on the local market's ability to overcome resistance levels in the next few days.
Reliance managed mild gains, adding seven cents to $22.50/23.50, while VSNL lost 30 cents to $18.50/19.50.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.75 points softer at 88.43, a 0.84 percent fall, with the premium over the local market at 20.56 percent from 20.29 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index shed 56.39 points to 4,321.98.

Korean GDRs were quietly firmer following a mostly flat showing from Seoul stocks. The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index was 0.70 points firmer at 76.88 points, a premium of 41.89 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 0.32 points higher at 134.25, representing a discount to the local market of 1.70 percent.
